items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

ctx.x: Yeah. Interesting. Did you and your brother have any kind of sibling rivalry going with the music?

Oh yes and no. We still have a little bit. But as we get older it kind of wanes in the noonday sun, as O. Henry said. We’ve learned to live with each other a little bit. But my brother has a tendency to be a little bit high strung. His temper can sometimes get the best of him. We’ve had our hassles over the years but basically we still get along pretty well. And we just did a record for this label that I record on, Nagel-Heyer Records, and this is “Mrs. Vache’s Boys,” that’s been selling very well, it just got…
You don’t call each other up every week and say so how many gigs did you have this week?
